Bronce.Calibres.desc: Raw blueberry caliber sizes from field evaluations. Stores diameter measurements by module, variety and evaluator with full audit trail.
Bronce.Calibres.source: Excel: /data/entrada/calibres/ → Cargador manual → Normalizacion de columnas
Bronce.Calibres.grain: One row per caliber evaluation event (by module+turno+variedad+fecha)
Bronce.Calibres.purpose: Field quality control measure for fruit consistency & harvest planning

Bronce.Censo_Plantas.desc: Plant population count by plot and variety state (healthy/regular/bad/dead). Wide or long format detection with automatic pivoting from state columns.
Bronce.Censo_Plantas.source: Excel: /data/entrada/censo_plantas/ → Smart layout detection (state columns) → Melt to long format
Bronce.Censo_Plantas.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, variedad, estado_planta)
Bronce.Censo_Plantas.purpose: Plant health monitoring for field loss tracking, replant planning & phytosanitary record

Bronce.Ciclos_Fenologicos.desc: Phenological stage tracking by organ color (buds/flowers/small fruit/mature). Marks development progress of fruit clusters with ribbon color coding.
Bronce.Ciclos_Fenologicos.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, organo, color) observation
Bronce.Ciclos_Fenologicos.purpose: Fruit ripeness tracking & harvest timing optimization via color bands & phenology markers

Bronce.Cierre_Mapas_Cosecha.desc: Harvest field mapping closure summary by module and variety. Final validation that all harvest blocks are complete and recorded.
Bronce.Cierre_Mapas_Cosecha.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, variedad) harvest block closure
Bronce.Cierre_Mapas_Cosecha.purpose: Harvest completion tracking & data integrity verification before season closeout

Bronce.Consolidado_Tareos.desc: Labor time tracking consolidated from field rosters (tareos). Hours worked by person, activity, labor type via SAP integration.
Bronce.Consolidado_Tareos.grain: One row per (fecha, dni_responsable, modulo, turno, actividad, labor) time record
Bronce.Consolidado_Tareos.purpose: Labor cost allocation, productivity KPIs, and operational benchmarking by activity

Bronce.Conteo_Fruta.desc: Fruit phenology count by developmental stage (buttons/flowers/small/mature/crema/harvest-ready). Core field count with 20+ metrics per point.
Bronce.Conteo_Fruta.source: Excel: /data/entrada/conteo_fruta/ → Multi-sheet reader (BD+Hoja1 or report header in row 2)
Bronce.Conteo_Fruta.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, punto, variedad) fruit stage count
Bronce.Conteo_Fruta.purpose: Harvest forecasting via fruit stage progression modeling & weekly supply projection

Bronce.Cosecha_SAP.desc: Harvest reconciliation from SAP with actual field pickings. Kg_Total, Area, plant count, and SAP-mapped semana_cosecha for alignment.
Bronce.Cosecha_SAP.source: SAP data export: /data/entrada/data_sap/ → SAP harvest extract with geography + weights
Bronce.Cosecha_SAP.grain: One row per (fecha, semana, modulo, turno, valvula, variedad) SAP harvest record
Bronce.Cosecha_SAP.purpose: Harvest volume truth-set for projection comparison, yield analytics, and SAP reconciliation

Bronce.Data_SAP.desc: SAP warehouse & logistics data including material codes, clients, storage, weights (gross/tare/net), shipment docs. Links harvest to post-harvest chain.
Bronce.Data_SAP.source: SAP extract: /data/entrada/data_sap/ → Warehouse receiving & despatch records
Bronce.Data_SAP.grain: One row per shipment record (fecha_cosecha, consumidor, variedad, lote, almacen, documento_remision)
Bronce.Data_SAP.purpose: Post-harvest quality tracking, client-level supply chain visibility, and fruit traceability

Bronce.Evaluacion_Calidad_Poda.desc: Pruning quality assessment by cuts, shoot diameter, basal shoot count, and defective cuts. Post-pruning harvest evaluation.
Bronce.Evaluacion_Calidad_Poda.source: Excel: /data/entrada/evaluacion_calidad_poda/ → Pruning metrics by plot element
Bronce.Evaluacion_Calidad_Poda.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, variedad, tipo_evaluacion) poda quality check
Bronce.Evaluacion_Calidad_Poda.purpose: Pruning execution QA and shoot quality standardization for consistent future cropping

Bronce.Evaluacion_Pesos.desc: Berry weight samples by stage (small/large/creams/mature/harvest-ready). Key for yield prediction via weight trajectory modeling.
Bronce.Evaluacion_Pesos.source: Excel: /data/entrada/evaluacion_pesos/ → Multi-format weight sampling (peso baya + muestra)
Bronce.Evaluacion_Pesos.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, variedad, tipo_evaluacion) weight sample
Bronce.Evaluacion_Pesos.purpose: Yield projection via weight curve analysis; per-berry kg estimation from sample data

Bronce.Evaluacion_Vegetativa.desc: Plant vegetative vigor by floor (piso 1-5) measuring: shoot count, productives, diameter, basal shoots, height. Comprehensive structure assessment.

Bronce.Evaluacion_Vegetativa.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, cama, variedad, semanas_poda) vegetative assessment
Bronce.Evaluacion_Vegetativa.purpose: Plant structure tracking for disease prediction, pollination potential, & harvest readiness forecast

Bronce.Fiscalizacion.desc: Compliance & field inspection records by inspector and module. Operational audits and labor compliance checks.
Bronce.Fiscalizacion.grain: One row per inspection event (fecha, dni, modulo, turno, evaluador)
Bronce.Fiscalizacion.purpose: Operational compliance auditing & field protocol enforcement tracking

Bronce.Fisiologia.desc: Plant physiological state: bud stages (hinchadas/productivas), total organs per tercio (third of plant height). Bud viability tracker.
Bronce.Fisiologia.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, variedad, brote, tercio) physiological observation
Bronce.Fisiologia.purpose: Flowering potential assessment via bud swelling & productivity predictions from organ counts

Bronce.Floracion.desc: Bloom evaluation: plant count in flower per cama (bed) and total evaluated. Early bloom detection & flowering synchrony.

Bronce.Floracion.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, cama, variedad) flowering event
Bronce.Floracion.purpose: Bloom timing synchrony, pollination window detection, & fruit set readiness

Bronce.Induccion_Floral.desc: Flowering induction results: plants induced, shoots with induction, shoots with flowers (post-induction success). Treatment response tracker.
Bronce.Induccion_Floral.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, cama, variedad, tipo_evaluacion) induction record
Bronce.Induccion_Floral.purpose: Flowering induction success rates & off-season flowering control tracking for crop management

Bronce.Maduracion.desc: Fruit maturation tracking by organ (berry) color using ribbon marks. Tracks days-to-harvest from color stage observation.
Bronce.Maduracion.source: Excel: /data/entrada/maduracion/ → Organ+Color tracking from marked fruit ribbons
Bronce.Maduracion.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, variedad, organo, color) maturation observation
Bronce.Maduracion.purpose: Harvest date optimization and on-tree fruit ripeness stage tracking

Bronce.Peladas.desc: Stripped/exposed berry count by phenological stage (buttons/flowers/small/large/creams/mature/harvest-ready). Measures disease/damage-exposed fruit.
Bronce.Peladas.source: Excel: /data/entrada/peladas/ → Peladas (desnudadas) de bayas por etapa fenologica
Bronce.Peladas.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, punto, variedad) pelada count event
Bronce.Peladas.purpose: Disease/damage exposure assessment & sanitation urgency detection for phytosanitary response

Bronce.Pintado_Flores.desc: Flower marking/painting status for controlled pollination & flowering induction experiments. Tracks marked flowers.
Bronce.Pintado_Flores.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, variedad) painting event
Bronce.Pintado_Flores.purpose: Pollination experiment control & marked crop harvest tracking

Bronce.Proyeccion_Pesos.desc: Weight projection by variety and harvest date. Model inputs for per-berry weight forecasting.
Bronce.Proyeccion_Pesos.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, variedad) weight projection
Bronce.Proyeccion_Pesos.purpose: Harvest yield forecasting via weight curve projections & per-berry kg estimation

Bronce.Reporte_Clima.desc: Daily climate summary: T_max/min, humidity, precipitation. Used for indirect crop modeling when telemetry unavailable.
Bronce.Reporte_Clima.source: Excel: /data/entrada/reporte_clima/ OR hourly telemetry → Daily aggregation
Bronce.Reporte_Clima.grain: One row per (fecha, hora, sector) climate measurement
Bronce.Reporte_Clima.purpose: Crop physiology modeling & disease risk prediction via temperature & humidity thresholds

Bronce.Reporte_Cosecha.desc: Harvest daily summary from field: kg net, jaba (box) count. SAP-like but from field reports.
Bronce.Reporte_Cosecha.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, turno, valvula, variedad) harvest day consolidation
Bronce.Reporte_Cosecha.purpose: Real-time harvest volume tracking & daily production reporting

Bronce.Seguimiento_Errores.desc: Field error tracking: plant loss (muertas), stagnation issues. Phytosanitary incident log.
Bronce.Seguimiento_Errores.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, variedad) error incident
Bronce.Seguimiento_Errores.purpose: Field health incident tracking & phytosanitary risk alerting

Bronce.Tasa_Crecimiento_Brotes.desc: Shoot growth rate measurements over time (historical & daily). Tracks shoot elongation from marking date to measurement.

Bronce.Tasa_Crecimiento_Brotes.purpose: Vegetative vigor assessment & shoot development rate tracking for pruning timing

Bronce.Variables_Meteorologicas.desc: Meteorological variables (VPD, Radiation) by sector. Sparse updates when available; supplementary to telemetry.
Bronce.Variables_Meteorologicas.grain: One row per (fecha, modulo, sector) met measurement
Bronce.Variables_Meteorologicas.purpose: Supplementary crop physiology modeling when real-time telemetry gaps exist

Bronce.Telemetria_Clima.desc: Continuous telemetry: hourly T_max/min/ext, humidity, rain, UV, GDD, wind, VPD. Source of truth for climate analytics.
Bronce.Telemetria_Clima.source: Automated logger: /data/entrada/telemetria_clima/ (por sector: A01, B02, etc.) → Extract sector from filename
Bronce.Telemetria_Clima.grain: One row per (semana, fecha_hora, sector) hourly climate reading
Bronce.Telemetria_Clima.purpose: Continuous crop physiology monitoring, disease risk modeling, & VPD/GDD calculations for scheduling

Silver.Dim_Actividad_Operativa.desc: Activity catalog: work task names and their associated labor codes (cultivo/cosecha/empaque). Links SAP to field operations.

Silver.Dim_Actividad_Operativa.purpose: Labor cost allocation & productivity metrics by operational task type

Silver.Dim_Cama_Catalogo.desc: Catalog of all bed/planting line codes in production. Normalized against typos & variations.

Silver.Dim_Campana.desc: Campaign/season master list: production season identifier with status (active/closed/archive). Cross-references all facts.

Silver.Dim_Campana.purpose: Temporal scoping for multi-season analytics & cross-campaign benchmarking

Silver.Dim_Cinta.desc: Ribbon color codes for fruit maturation stage marking (rojo/naranja/amarillo/verde). Tracks marked fruit ripeness.
Silver.Dim_Cinta.purpose: Fruit ripeness stage classification for harvest timing optimization

Silver.Dim_Condicion_Cultivo.desc: Growing condition types: sustrato (soil/hydro/coconut coir) and certification (organic/conventional). Links to production method.
Silver.Dim_Condicion_Cultivo.purpose: Harvest reconciliation scoping & yield model stratification by growing method

Silver.Dim_Escenario_Proyeccion.desc: Projection model scenarios: optimistic/pessimistic/base case with 6/12/20-week horizons. Model variant tracking.
Silver.Dim_Escenario_Proyeccion.purpose: Projection ensemble scoping & forecast confidence band definition

Silver.Dim_Estado_Fenologico.desc: Phenological stage ontology: buds/flowers/small fruit/medium/large/mature/harvest. Ordered progression from flower to ripeness.

Silver.Dim_Estado_Workflow.desc: Projection workflow states: draft/validated/override/rejected/published. Production release decision states.

Silver.Dim_Estado_Workflow.purpose: Projection approval flow tracking & version control

Silver.Dim_Fundo_Catalogo.desc: Farm/estate master list: Fundo names (Las Cruces/San Martin/etc). Top geography hierarchy level.

Silver.Dim_Modulo_Catalogo.desc: Module (growing section) catalog with optional sub-module and training system (umbrella/espalier/etc).
Silver.Dim_Modulo_Catalogo.source: Bronce.[all] → Unique modulo_raw → MDM homologacion → Dim_Modulo_Catalogo
Silver.Dim_Modulo_Catalogo.grain: One row per (modulo, submodulo, tipo_conduccion) combination
Silver.Dim_Modulo_Catalogo.purpose: Plot-level geography reference & production method classification

Silver.Dim_Personal.desc: Employee directory: DNI, full name, role, sex, payroll ID, asertivity pct %, absenteeism days. Field worker master.

Silver.Dim_Personal.purpose: Labor KPI tracking (accuracy, attendance) & field responsibility assignment

Silver.Dim_Sector_Catalogo.desc: Production sector/zone codes (geographic divisions within a farm). Grouping above modules.
Silver.Dim_Sector_Catalogo.source: Bronce.[all] → Unique sector_raw → MDM homologacion → Dim_Sector_Catalogo
Silver.Dim_Sector_Catalogo.purpose: Mid-level geography hierarchy for climate zone stratification & field clustering

Silver.Dim_Tiempo.desc: Date dimension with ISO week, cosecha week, day-of-week, month name, weekend flag. Bridges gregorian & agricultural calendar.
Silver.Dim_Tiempo.purpose: Time-based fact aggregation & harvest season alignment across gregorian/agri-calendars

Silver.Dim_Turno_Catalogo.desc: Shift codes (1/2/3 or A/B/C). Identifies work shift for labor & field operations.
Silver.Dim_Turno_Catalogo.source: Bronce.[all] → Unique turno_raw → MDM homologacion → Dim_Turno_Catalogo

Silver.Dim_Valvula_Catalogo.desc: Irrigation valve/water block codes. Sub-module irrigation zone identifier.
Silver.Dim_Valvula_Catalogo.source: Bronce.[all] → Unique valvula_raw → MDM homologacion → Dim_Valvula_Catalogo
Silver.Dim_Valvula_Catalogo.purpose: Water management zone reference & irrigation-based crop segmentation

Silver.Dim_Variedad.desc: Blueberry variety master: variety name and breeder. Genetic classification for yield model stratification.
Silver.Dim_Variedad.source: Bronce.[all] → Unique variedad_raw → MDM homologacion → Dim_Variedad
Silver.Dim_Variedad.purpose: Variety-specific yield model parameters, disease resistance profiles, & harvest scheduling

Silver.Fact_areas_plantas.desc: Area (hectares) and plant count by geography, variety, and date. Supports per-plant and per-hectare yield calculations.

Silver.Fact_areas_plantas.purpose: Per-plant yield normalization & area-adjusted productivity metrics

Silver.Fact_Censo_Plantas.desc: Plant health census: counts of healthy/regular/bad plants by geography and date. Population health tracker.
Silver.Fact_Censo_Plantas.grain: One row per (fecha, id_geografia, id_variedad, id_campana) census date
Silver.Fact_Censo_Plantas.purpose: Field health monitoring for replant planning & attrition forecasting

Silver.Fact_Ciclo_Poda.desc: Pruning quality metrics: shoot counts, lengths, diameters, defects per geography. Post-pruning crop structure assessment.
Silver.Fact_Ciclo_Poda.grain: One row per (fecha, id_geografia, id_variedad, id_campana) poda observation
Silver.Fact_Ciclo_Poda.purpose: Pruning quality QA & shoot structure standardization tracking

Silver.Fact_Ciclos_Fenologicos.desc: Fruit phenology and ripeness by color ribbon marking (cinta). Tracks marked fruit development stages.

Silver.Fact_Ciclos_Fenologicos.purpose: Harvest timing optimization via fruit ripeness stage tracking & color-based ripeness classification

Silver.Fact_Conteo_Fenologico.desc: Fruit phenological stage count: total organs by stage (buds/flowers/small/medium/large/mature) per geography. Core forecasting input.

Silver.Fact_Conteo_Fenologico.grain: One row per (fecha, id_geografia, id_variedad, id_estado_fenologico, id_personal, id_campana) phenology count
Silver.Fact_Conteo_Fenologico.purpose: Harvest supply forecasting via fruit stage progression modeling; core input to 6-week projection models

Silver.Fact_Cosecha_SAP.desc: Harvest actuals from SAP: kg_neto_mp by geography, variety, date, and cultivation condition. Source-of-truth yield data.

Silver.Fact_Cosecha_SAP.purpose: Harvest volume truth-set for projection model comparison, yield analytics, & forecast accuracy measurement

Silver.Fact_Evaluacion_Pesos.desc: Berry weight samples by stage: average g/berry with projected harvest weight and sample size per geography/date.

Silver.Fact_Evaluacion_Pesos.purpose: Berry weight trajectory modeling for yield prediction; per-berry kg curve fitting from samples

Silver.Fact_Evaluacion_Vegetativa.desc: Plant vegetative structure by floor (piso): shoot count, productivity ratio, heights by geography and week post-pruning.

Silver.Fact_Evaluacion_Vegetativa.purpose: Plant structure tracking for disease prediction, pollination assessment, & crop maturity validation

Silver.Fact_Fisiologia.desc: Plant physiology: bud swelling states (hinchadas/productivas) and total organs per canopy third. Bud viability indicator.
Silver.Fact_Fisiologia.grain: One row per (fecha, id_geografia, id_variedad, tercio, id_campana) physiology observation
Silver.Fact_Fisiologia.purpose: Flowering potential prediction & bud set assessment for off-season flowering control

Silver.Fact_Floracion.purpose: Bloom synchrony & pollination window detection for fruit set optimization

Silver.Fact_Induccion_Floral.desc: Off-season flowering induction: success rate (plants induced, shoots with flowers post-treatment). Treatment response tracker.

Silver.Fact_Induccion_Floral.purpose: Flowering induction protocol validation & counter-seasonal harvest scheduling success rate

Silver.Fact_Maduracion.desc: Fruit maturation progress via ribbon color marking: days elapsed from marking, color state, organ/cluster tracking.

Silver.Fact_Maduracion.grain: One row per (fecha, id_geografia, id_variedad, id_cinta, id_organo, id_estado_fenologico, id_campana) marked fruit tracking
Silver.Fact_Maduracion.purpose: Harvest scheduling precision via on-tree ripeness stage monitoring and color-coded fruit classification

Silver.Fact_Peladas.desc: Exposed/stripped berry count (damage/disease): by stage per geography. Sanitation urgency indicator.

Silver.Fact_Peladas.grain: One row per (fecha, id_geografia, id_variedad, id_estado_fenologico, id_personal, punto, id_campana) pelada count
Silver.Fact_Peladas.purpose: Disease/damage exposure tracking & phytosanitary response triggering

Silver.Fact_Proyecciones.desc: Weekly harvest forecast: kg_proyectados by scenario (base/optimistic/pessimistic) with MAPE accuracy & override flags.

Silver.Fact_Tareo.desc: Labor timesheet: hours worked by worker, activity, labor type per date and geography. SAP-linked payroll records.

Silver.Fact_Tareo.purpose: Labor cost allocation, productivity KPIs by task type, & payroll integration

Silver.Fact_Tasa_Crecimiento_Brotes.desc: Shoot elongation rate (cm/day) from marking to measurement. Growth vigor indicator for pruning timing.

Silver.Fact_Tasa_Crecimiento_Brotes.purpose: Vegetative vigor assessment & optimal pruning window determination

Silver.Fact_Telemetria_Clima.desc: Continuous hourly climate: T_exterior, T_max/min, humidity, precipitation, UV, radiation, VPD (calculated). 24/7 microclimate monitoring.

Gold.Mart_Clima.desc: Climate analytics: daily avg/max temps, VPD, humidity, rainfall, GDD by sector and week. Crop physiology input.
Gold.Mart_Clima.source: Silver.Fact_Telemetria_Clima → Daily aggregation with Tetens VPD + GDD calculation → Gold.Mart_Clima
Gold.Mart_Clima.grain: One row per (id_tiempo, sector_climatico, semana_iso, id_campana) daily climate summary
Gold.Mart_Clima.purpose: Climate-crop physiology analytics: disease risk, heat stress, irrigation scheduling DSS

Gold.Mart_Cosecha.desc: Weekly harvest summary: kg_neto (actual) vs kg_proyectados (forecast) with fulfillment %, by geography/variety.
Gold.Mart_Cosecha.source: Silver.Fact_Cosecha_SAP + Silver.Fact_Proyecciones → Join by (fecha, geografia, variedad, campana) → Gold.Mart_Cosecha
Gold.Mart_Cosecha.grain: One row per (semana_iso, id_geografia, id_variedad, id_campana) harvest week
Gold.Mart_Cosecha.purpose: Weekly supply/sales dashboard: actual vs forecast fulfillment tracking & forecast accuracy metrics

Gold.Mart_Evaluacion_Vegetativa.desc: Vegetative structure summary by floor: avg heights, shoots, diameters, productivity ratio (productive/total) by geography/week.
Gold.Mart_Evaluacion_Vegetativa.source: Silver.Fact_Evaluacion_Vegetativa → Aggregate by semana_iso + piso + modulo
Gold.Mart_Evaluacion_Vegetativa.grain: One row per (semana_iso, piso, id_geografia, id_variedad, id_campana)
Gold.Mart_Evaluacion_Vegetativa.purpose: Plant structure dashboard for agronomists: vigor assessment, disease risk prediction, harvest readiness

Gold.Mart_Fenologia.desc: Phenological stage summary: fruit count by stage (buttons/flowers/small/medium/large/mature/harvest) by geography/week.
Gold.Mart_Fenologia.source: Silver.Fact_Conteo_Fenologico + Silver.Fact_Fisiologia + Silver.Fact_Ciclos_Fenologicos → Aggregate by semana_iso
Gold.Mart_Fenologia.grain: One row per (semana_iso, modulo, variedad, id_estado_fenologico, id_campana)
Gold.Mart_Fenologia.purpose: Harvest forecasting dashboard: fruit stage progression model tracking & supply projection input validation

Gold.Mart_Induccion_Floral.desc: Induction campaign summary: success rate (% plants induced with flowers) by geography and campaign for counter-seasonal crops.
Gold.Mart_Induccion_Floral.grain: One row per (id_geografia, id_variedad, id_campana) induction campaign
Gold.Mart_Induccion_Floral.purpose: Off-season flowering control dashboard & counter-seasonal harvest scheduling effectiveness tracking

Gold.Mart_Pesos_Calibres.desc: Berry weight analysis: avg g/berry by stage + caliber distribution (small/medium/large). Harvest quality metrics.
Gold.Mart_Pesos_Calibres.source: Silver.Fact_Evaluacion_Pesos + Bronce.Calibres → Join + weight curve fitting → Gold.Mart_Pesos_Calibres
Gold.Mart_Pesos_Calibres.grain: One row per (semana_iso, id_geografia, id_variedad, id_campana) weight tracking week
Gold.Mart_Pesos_Calibres.purpose: Harvest quality dashboard: berry weight progression, caliber distribution, fruit maturity validation

Gold.Mart_Proyecciones.desc: Projection executive summary: weekly kg_proyectados (base scenario) by geography/variety with MAPE, override flags, model version.
Gold.Mart_Proyecciones.source: Silver.Fact_Proyecciones (filtered on ESCENARIO_PROYECCION_OFICIAL) → Join with actuals → Gold.Mart_Proyecciones
Gold.Mart_Proyecciones.grain: One row per (semana_iso, id_geografia, id_variedad, id_campana) projection week
Gold.Mart_Proyecciones.purpose: Executive forecast dashboard: weekly harvest supply projection, accuracy tracking, override audit trail

Gold.Mart_Tasa_Crecimiento.desc: Growth rate summary: avg cm/day shoot elongation by condition (experiment/control) and geography. Pruning timing decision support.
Gold.Mart_Tasa_Crecimiento.grain: One row per (semana_iso, id_geografia, id_variedad, condicion, id_campana) growth tracking period
Gold.Mart_Tasa_Crecimiento.purpose: Pruning schedule DSS: growth rate tracking & optimal pruning window determination

Auditoria.Carga_Archivos.desc: Audit log of file loads: which file loaded to which table when, status (OK/ERROR), row counts, errors. Complete data lineage.
Auditoria.Carga_Archivos.grain: One row per file load event
Auditoria.Carga_Archivos.purpose: Data lineage & ETL execution audit trail for compliance & debugging

Control.Parametros_Pipeline.desc: ETL configuration: fact blockers, scenario IDs, projection horizons, DQ thresholds. Single source of truth for pipeline logic.
Control.Parametros_Pipeline.source: Config.parametros.py → Stored as JSON in Control.Parametros_Pipeline
Control.Parametros_Pipeline.purpose: ETL configuration management & feature flags (facts_bloqueantes, escenario_oficial, dq_thresholds)

Seguridad.Roles_Acceso.desc: Role-based access control: user groups and table-level permissions (read/write/admin). Multi-tenancy scoping.
Seguridad.Roles_Acceso.grain: One row per (rol, tabla, permiso) assignment
Seguridad.Roles_Acceso.purpose: Data access control & Portal MDM user permission enforcement

Config.Homologacion_MDM.desc: Data homologation rules: raw value → normalized value mappings for all catalogs (fundo/modulo/turno/valvula/cama/variedad). Master data governance.
Config.Homologacion_MDM.source: Manual MDM rules + Portal MDM edits → Config.Homologacion_MDM
Config.Homologacion_MDM.grain: One row per (tabla_destino, valor_raw, valor_normalizado) mapping rule
Config.Homologacion_MDM.purpose: Raw field data standardization & data quality consistency across all sources

medallion_structure.bronce: Raw Excel/SAP ingestion, all NVARCHAR, preserve original values with audit trail
medallion_structure.silver: Cleaned, normalized facts & dimensions with MDM rules, typed columns, quality gates
medallion_structure.gold: Aggregated marts for Power BI, fact joins, week-level grain, executive reporting
